title: HD-sEMG motor-unit decomposition recovers the openhdemg reference

dataset.name: openhdemg sample file (emg_from_samplefile)
dataset.record: real HD-sEMG, OT Bioelettronica, 64 channels x 66,560 samples @ 2048 Hz
dataset.citation: Valli G, et al. openhdemg: a community-based platform for the analysis of high-density surface EMG. J Electromyogr Kinesiol. 2024.

proposition: From real HD-sEMG, PhysioHDEMG recovers 4 of the 5 openhdemg reference motor units at lag-aware rate-of-agreement 0.79-0.99 (three above 0.95), comparable to published inter-tool decomposition agreement.

validation.data: REAL — openhdemg sample HD-sEMG (64 ch @ 2048 Hz)
validation.note: 4 of 5 reference MUs recovered at RoA 0.79-0.99 (MU2/MU4/MU5 > 0.95); each recovered unit has PNR 20.8-22.8 dB and SIL 0.85-0.92. Reference MU3 was not recovered in this run (RoA 0.017) — a partial-recovery consistent with published inter-tool decomposition agreement, corrected from an earlier VAL-12 report.

open_questions.q: One reference unit (MU3) was not recovered. Partial recovery is typical of independent HD-sEMG decomposition and is documented, not escalated; a resolved methodological limitation rather than an unresolved research question.
